title: Federated Language Models Under Bandwidth Budgets: Distillation Rates and Conformal Coverage
abstract: arXiv:2605.09986v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Hospitals, companies, and research consortia want language models that learn from, and answer questions over, data that must stay where it is held, over links with limited bandwidth, such as the satellite links of remote clinics and ships. Averaging the sites' model parameters makes each message grow with the model and requires one shared architecture; methods that exchange predictions avoid both limits, but, to our knowledge, none bounds what compressing those predictions costs. We introduce two methods that compress every message at a small and predictable cost. Federated Probe-Logit Distillation (FPLD) trains a shared language model: each site sends compressed logits on shared unlabeled probes, and a hub distills one model from their average. translated_title: 带宽预算约束下的联邦语言模型：蒸馏速率与共形覆盖
translated_abstract: 医院、公司和研究联盟希望语言模型能够从必须保留在本地（数据不出域）的数据中学习并基于这些数据回答问题，且需要通过带宽有限的链路进行通信，例如偏远诊所和船只所使用的卫星链路。对各站点模型参数进行平均的方法会使每条消息随模型规模增大而增长，并且要求所有站点使用统一的模型架构；而交换预测结果的方法可以同时避免这两个限制，但据我们所知，目前尚没有方法能够限定压缩这些预测所带来的代价。我们提出了两种方法，能够以较小且可预测的代价压缩每条消息。联邦探测-逻辑值蒸馏（Federated Probe-Logit Distillation, FPLD）用于训练一个共享语言模型：每个站点在共享的无标注探测样本上发送压缩后的逻辑值，由中心节点从其平均值中蒸馏出一个模型。联邦共形检索增强生成（Federated Conformal Retrieval-Augmented Generation, FC-RAG）用于回答问题：每个站点使用自己的文档对候选答案进行评分并发送压缩后的分数，由中心节点返回一个综合
tldr: 该论文提出了两种在带宽受限、数据不出域场景下以小而可预测的代价压缩每条通信消息的联邦学习方法——FPLD（联邦探测-逻辑值蒸馏）用于跨站点联合训练共享语言模型，FC-RAG（联邦共形检索增强生成）用于跨站点协同问答。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces two federated methods—Federated Probe-Logit Distillation (FPLD) for collaboratively training a shared language model and Federated Conformal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (FC-RAG) for cross-site question answering—that compress every message at a small, predictable cost, overcoming the limits of parameter averaging and unbounded prediction compression under bandwidth constraints.
